Net cash used in operating activities during the year ended December 31, 2024 totaled $14.2 million, which included a $123.7 million decrease in working capital, principally related to continued inventory management actions and cash collections, $45.0 million of dividends received from Americas Styrenics and $33.9 million in deferred interest cash payments via the PIK Interest Election.

da.text: We present Adjusted EBITDA as a non-GAAP financial performance measure, which we define as income from continuing operations before interest expense, net; provision for income taxes; depreciation and amortization expense; loss on extinguishment of long-term debt; asset impairment charges; gains or losses on the dispositions of businesses and assets; restructuring charges; acquisition related costs and other items. In doing so, we are providing management, investors, and credit rating agencies with an indicator of our ongoing performance and business trends, removing the impact of transactions and events that we would not consider a part of our core operations.

wc.text: As of December 31, 2025, we had total Liquidity of $334.2 million, consisting of $139.4 million of cash and cash equivalents and $194.8 million of borrowing availability under the 2026 Revolving Facility and the Accounts Receivable Securitization Facility ($191.6 million and $3.2 million, respectively). We had $2,591.4 million of outstanding indebtedness as of December 31, 2025, compared to $2,448.4 million at December 31, 2024, and working capital of $150.0 million and $267.3 million at those respective dates. Of our cash, $89.6 million and $107.7 million, respectively, was held outside Ireland (our country of domicile), all of which is readily convertible into other currencies including U.S. dollars. Because we do not intend to indefinitely reinvest foreign cash, we record deferred tax liabilities on unremitted earnings. Additional information about our debt, rates, and maturities is provided in Note 16 to the consolidated financial statements.

capex.text: Net cash used in investing activities during the year ended December 31, 2025 totaled $41.0 million, which was primarily attributable to capital expenditures of $51.0 million offset by proceeds from the sale of business and other assets of $10.0 million. During 2025, the Company continued to proactively reduce or defer capital expenditures during the year to preserve liquidity.

fcf.heading: Free Cash Flow
fcf.text:
We use Free Cash Flow as a non-GAAP measure to evaluate and discuss the Company’s liquidity position and results. Free Cash Flow is defined as cash from operating activities, less capital expenditures. We believe that Free Cash Flow provides an indicator of the Company’s ongoing ability to generate cash through core operations, as it excludes the cash impacts of various financing transactions as well as cash flows from business combinations that are not considered organic in nature. We also believe that Free Cash Flow provides management and investors with useful analytical indicator of our ability to service our indebtedness, pay dividends (when declared), and meet our ongoing cash obligations.

Free Cash Flow is not intended to represent cash flows from operations as defined by GAAP, and therefore, should not be used as an alternative for that measure. Other companies in our industry may define Free Cash Flow differently than we do. As a result, it may be difficult to use this or similarly-named financial measures that other companies may use to compare the liquidity and cash generation of those companies to our own.

net sales.heading: Net Sales
net sales.text: Net sales decreased 15% compared to the prior year, reflecting a 10% reduction in sales volumes across all business segments due to continued weakness in end-market demand and a 6% decrease from lower pricing. These impacts were partially offset by a 1% benefit from favorable foreign currency exchange rates.

lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Other receivables
lines.why: Owed by suppliers and others, not by customers (vendor non-trade receivables): operating.

lines.name: Inventory
lines.why: Goods held for sale: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Goodwill
lines.why: Paid for acquired businesses: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Equity-method investments
lines.why: Stakes in associated businesses, usually part of operations. Financial if held as an investment.

lines.name: Deferred tax assets
lines.why: Taxes on operating income paid ahead: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Income taxes payable
lines.why: Taxes on operating income: operating.

lines.name: Other current liabilities
lines.why: Other operating items due within a year: operating.

lines.name: Current portion of long-term debt
lines.why: Borrowed money falling due within a year: financial.

lines.name: Long-term debt
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans: financial.

lines.name: Finance lease liabilities
lines.why: Leases that work like a loan for the asset: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Pension and retiree benefits
lines.why: Promised to employees for their work: operating (some analysts treat the unfunded part as debt).

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities
lines.why: Other long-term operating obligations: operating.

lines.name: Other current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current assets minus the current lines above: current assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current assets (total assets − current assets) minus the non-current lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current liabilities minus the current lines above: current liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current liabilities (total liabilities − current liabilities) minus the non-current lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
